visualStyleNotes: Geometry, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A flat rectangle on a board covered with an outlined grid of unit squares, dimension tags, and a live counter. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Board: warm paper panel (roughness ~0.5). Rectangle surface: warm paper with faint grid lines. Unit squares: subtle ink outlines over the surface. Dimension tags: small warm paper tags with ink numbers. Counter plate: warm paper with a live number. Formula plate: warm paper with ink 'length × width'. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: area as the count of square units — a tiled rectangle whose sides are draggable; a live tile counter; count and triangle-half demos.

GEOMETRY: A flat rectangle on a board, filled with a grid of outlined unit squares. Corner drag changes width and height; the grid re-lays out and the counter tag updates. 'Count' flashes each unit square in sequence as the total counts up. 'Triangle half' draws a diagonal, dims half the tiles, and shows the triangle area = 1/2 rectangle. Dimension tags along the edges show length and width.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) board; (2) rectangle surface; (3) unit-square grid; (4) counter + dimension tags.

CAMERA: high three-quarter above the board, frames the full rectangle; labels legible. Budget 5-10k triangles. Named nodes: Board, RectangleSurface, UnitGrid, CounterTag, DimensionTags, TriangleSplit, CountAnimation. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
